newsitem.title: USA: Kitty Hawk positive on growth in rest of 97.
newsitem.headline: Kitty Hawk positive on growth in rest of 97.

text.p: Kitty Hawk Inc said Wednesday it feels positive about its growth prospects for the rest of 1997.
The company said it expects continued strong growth in its air freight carrier business and slow and steady growth in the its air charter logistics management business.
In addition, the company said it sould see revenues increases if production at U.S. auto makers resumes at full capacity.
The company reported a profit per share of $0.25 compared to a loss per share of $0.16.
The company said its results were driven by a 20 percent increase in its air freight carrier business.
Revenues from the company's air charter logistics management operations were $14.0 million compared with $16.8 million a year ago.

The company said this decline was primarily the result of ongoing labor difficulties at U.S. auto manufacturers, which has slowed demand for logistics management services to move parts, inventory, and equipment.
The company also said it continues to diversify its customer base to lessen dependence on auto manufacturers, which comprise a significant portion of the air charter business.
Revenues from the air freight carrier business were $18.3 million compared to $15.2 million.
